claims.claim_text: Climate change is an urgent threat and a defining challenge in 2016.
By 2016, fifteen of the sixteen hottest years on record have occurred in the twenty-first century.
Donald Trump has described climate change as a hoax.
Global temperatures in 2016 are on track to set another record.
By 2016, rising seas already threaten U.S. cities from Miami to Baltimore.
By 2016, California and the western United States have suffered years of severe drought.
By 2016, Alaska has suffered severe wildfires, New York has experienced superstorms, and Texas has experienced flash floods.

Scientific evidence indicates that without ambitious, immediate, economy-wide reductions in carbon pollution and other greenhouse gases, rising seas, droughts, wildfires, severe storms and flash floods will become far worse.
Opposition to leaving U.S. children a planet profoundly damaged by climate change.
